Hi Lucas / team —

Attached is the inventory spreadsheet and a one-page dataflow sketch. Summary below (high level):

- Core serving: Redwood Serving Inc. (on our infra) — EU processing for EU tenants, region: eu-central-1 (required)
- Object storage / customer assets: EdgeStore Ltd. — primary processing eu-west-1 (required for customer uploads)
- Observability/metrics: StreamWatch — processing in eu-central-1 by default; aggregated metrics for product improvements are filtered for EU tenants and retained within EU. (optional for diagnostics — can be disabled per-tenant)
- Logging/trace storage: LogSafe (third-party) — processing/ingestion in eu-central-1; export to US only for backups/DR (we can enable onshore-only backup on request).
- Egress/caching partner: CDNPlus — EU POPs; small fraction of edge telemetry may leave for cache invalidation analytics (optional)

Minimal scope guidance (required vs optional):
- Required: Serving runtime, object storage, KMS for key management (see below), and the regional egress/CDN for content delivery.
- Optional: Aggregated analytics/observability vendors and long-term archival backups.

Telemetry / logs: Naomi validated that telemetry for EU tenants is processed within EU POPs by default. Non-essential telemetry exports to the US are opt-in (e.g., aggregated product analytics). We do retain some encrypted backup snapshots to an onshore (US) cold-storage for disaster recovery; if EdgePay requires no cross-border backup, we can propose a contractual onshore-only backup clause in the DPA.

KMS note: We use customer-segregated keys within our KMS. For EU-resident tenants we can keep key material in EU-bound KMS instances (managed) or support a customer-managed key (bring-your-own-key) arrangement for full control.

Next steps:
- If this matches your needs, we'll push a short attestation (one paragraph) for the DPA annex.
- If you need complete export logs/evidence, we can provide a limited export package (audit log slice) under an NDA.

Let me know which option you prefer.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference
